title: Native engineering workbench with shared Rust core
summary: Tauri desktop and JSON CLI share repository inspection and engineering action logic, with a React/TypeScript interface.

dates.note: Exact start/end dates are not documented. Technical mechanisms are reported in the October 5, 2026 snapshot; any later owner clarifications are cited per fact.

facts.text: Built a Tauri 2 engineering workbench with a React/TypeScript UI and shared Rust application core consumed by both the desktop interface and a JSON CLI.
Implemented bounded asynchronous repository inspection, separating expensive Git refreshes from independent process-state updates.
Hardened registered engineering actions through identifier/slot/argument validation, environment controls and timeouts; direct actions launch argument arrays without a shell.
Delegated renderer operations to the existing workspace implementation rather than duplicating project runtime behavior.
